questionSnapshot.question: What are the four main theme parks at Walt Disney World?
answers: Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom
Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, Universal
Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Adventureland, Animal Kingdom
Magic Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, SeaWorld

notes: Distinct from locating one attraction or identifying a park theme. Answer lengths are sufficiently parallel. Checked all four final options, mobile wording, clue fairness, category, editorial difficulty and theatrical/character/park scope. Full topic digests and additional all-shard searches were used for distinctness; context questions are not approved by this review.
